shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in package.json next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json tsconfig.json && find .next/server/app -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -n \"Dashboard|Loading dashboard|Revenue|BAILOUT|postpon\" .next/server/app -g '*.*' | sed -n '1,180p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,80p' app/loading.tsx && git diff -- app"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,6p' .next/server/app/index.html && node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const html=fs.readFileSync('.next/server/app/index.html','utf8'); for (const s of ['

Dashboard

','Total Revenue','Total Invoices','Loading revenue...','Loading invoices...','Loading dashboard...']) console.log(s, html.includes(s));\" && git diff --check && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'unlink /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- tsconfig.json'
